parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Pushjet destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-pushjet` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `pjet://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`host_secret`, `secret_key_secret`); the `gateway` and `gateway-plus` transformer channels skip Apprise and POST a native Pushjet message payload directly to your Pushjet server. The `gateway` channel is free; `gateway-plus` costs $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment destinations.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Pushjet destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your own Pushjet server (no Apprise)

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushjet host

secret_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushjet secret key
